items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: I went out to dance one night with my cousin Margaret

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything else about your family? Did your father favor you?

Oh no, no indeed. No indeed, man, no indeed. You see, my father was a plasterer. And my uncle was a bricklayer, and my grandfather was a plasterer. And it was just the customs of the Creoles that nobody was supposed to break away from nothing. If he was a plasterer, then I was supposed to be a plasterer. Well, when I got to be around 16 years old, they took me, him and Sam Augustin, which was Johnny St. Cyr's stepfather. I went to work with them as a plasterer's apprentice, getting $1.60 a day.
